concept: Review and integration: standing for a principle when it costs something
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across integrity, loyalty, and defeat — which was hardest for you to navigate, and why?
exercise.practice: Student identifies one real (or realistic) situation in their own life where this Pillar applies

assessment.success_marker: student connects at least two of the three teen-stage scenarios into a coherent personal view of honor
